title: Command launcher
description: Filter actions and navigate results immediately from the keyboard.
useCase: Filter actions and navigate results immediately from the keyboard.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Local action selection only. No global keyboard shortcut is registered by the gallery example.
look: Charcoal page with a graphite rounded panel: search field, four icon-led action rows with letter keycaps, the first highlighted, and a small hint footer.
motion: No transitions: typing filters the actions instantly, arrow keys or pointer movement jump the highlight between rows, Enter or click shows the choice in the footer, Escape clears.
adapt: Filtering is `list` (substring match on `query`), the highlight is `index` reflected in `aria-selected` and `aria-activedescendant`, and `onKeyDown` handles arrows, Enter and Escape. Replace `commands` and `setChosen` with real actions and add a global shortcut to open it.
